issues.source_quote: Сидячий? - Чего? - Сидит? - Кто? - Мужик этот твой! - Во деревня! Ну ты даешь! Кто же его посадит? Он же памятник!
issues.translation_quote: Was he inside? - Inside what? - Sitting inside? - Who? - Your man! Inside the statue! - What a bumpkin! You don't get it! How could he be inside? The man is the statue!
issues.justification: The joke plays on 'сидячий' (seated statue) versus 'сидеть' (be in prison / be put away). The translation invents 'inside the statue', which makes no sense and destroys the humor.

issues.translation_quote: So weak-willed he nicked our money and blamed the taxi driver.
issues.justification: Consistent with source, but earlier 'Шакал я паршивый' / 'Hell if I know' etc. fine; however 'Ты б лучше шлем нашел' was rendered fine. (Main issue: 'Шерсть' item) — the gift 'Носи на здоровье, домашние' is rendered as 'slippers' with 'These' added, while 'Чистая шерсть' is for socks; the translation adds 'They're slippers' unclear, minor distortion.

issues.source_quote: Те сидят там, в Средней Азии, а этот под Москвой.
issues.translation_quote: Those two are in Central Asia; this one's near Moscow.
issues.justification: Omits the point that the men were already convicted; also 'Хмыренок/Хмырь' naming inconsistent: 'Little Grump' vs 'Grump' loses 'хмырь' (shady type) flavor.

issues.source_quote: Ты на третьем, ты на пятом! Выполняйте!
issues.translation_quote: Go! Goodbye! Courtesy is a thief's best weapon.
issues.justification: Fine in itself, but the important gag 'Сидит? ... Он же памятник' aside, the 'Во дает! ... Рожи-то у нас у всех хороши' is OK. Key failure: 'Я умер' (the wife joke: 'Умерла? — Я умер') is rendered 'I'm the one who died' acceptable; but the chess/'Ходи лошадью' scene's 'Мат. Отдавайте пиджак' stakes are muddled by 'Is that all?' / 'Thank you for your concern', which misrender 'Все? / Благодарю за внимание'.

issues.source_quote: Доцент, а Доцент, а шкаряты себе милицейские купил! Так это восточный базар был, а не ГУМ.
issues.translation_quote: Docent! You bought yourself policeman's boots! That was a street market, not a department store.
issues.justification: 'Шкаряты' is thieves' slang and Soviet cultural markers (ГУМ) are flattened; underworld voice lost.

issues.source_quote: Нам не страшен серый волк... Я злой и страшный серый волк, я в поросятах знаю толк.
issues.translation_quote: We're not afraid of the big bad wolf, the big bad wolf... I'm the big bad wolf, a fearsome beast; on little piggies I love to feast!
issues.justification: Acceptable rhyme, but 'Только, знаешь, это страшнее' ('it's scarier') is mistranslated as 'he's scarier than that', changing meaning of the exchange; also 'Ненормальный пришел' softened to 'odd fellow'.

issues.source_quote: Ее: Ограбление? - Гоп-стоп. - Нехороший человек? - Редиска. - Хороший человек? Забыл! Фрей-фея
issues.translation_quote: A good person? I forgot! A swell guy. That's right, a swell guy.
issues.justification: 'Фрей-фея' is the underworld word the character forgets; translation resolves it as 'swell guy', losing the comic forgetfulness and the slang lesson. Also 'Редиска' rendered 'rotten radish' is odd English, though kept consistent.
Untranslated Soviet acronym (anti-embezzlement police); target audience cannot grasp the joke that the thieves mishear 'yes' as a police agency.

issues.translation_quote: Dinner is served! Please sit down and stuff your faces.
issues.justification: Acceptable, but 'Вам по 40 лет' / 'Ваших подопечных' etc. The humor of polite-yet-crude register is partly kept; minor.

issues.translation_quote: The one who put old woman in the well?
issues.justification: Ungrammatical English; if intentional broken speech, inconsistent. Also the doctor is called 'старуха' loosely.

issues.source_quote: Если б мы еще шапка принесли!
issues.translation_quote: If only we'd brought helmet too!
issues.justification: Broken English reflects the source's deliberate accent, but it is inconsistent across the text with other characters' speech.

issues.translation_quote: A city beginning with N. Vorkuta.
issues.justification: The cities game is adapted to W (Moscow→Warsaw→Wellington), but then 'N' is demanded and 'A' for Dzhambul, which no longer matches; the game logic breaks.

issues.translation_quote: He'll sell us out, Docent. He'll spill everything.
issues.justification: 'Spill' later glossed as 'to spill: betray' while 'расколоться' earlier rendered differently; terminology inconsistent.
